scripts.text:
[Boya]
What's up?
If you have any normal missions use the bulletin board.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
有什么事？
普通任务请看公告板。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You are not in my group are you?
I don't have anything to say to outsiders.
If you want something register with my group.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你不是我小队的成员吧？
我没什么可对外人说的。
想要什么就先加入我们小队。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Hey, I already talked all about the training areas.
I will explain again please concentrate.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
喂，训练地点的事我都讲过了。
我再说一遍，你仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The training name was 'Conquer the Culvert!.
Did you explore the culvert fully?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
训练项目叫“征服下水道”！
你把下水道彻底探索过了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Oh you've come back.
Good job.
Now you are adapting.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
哦，你回来了。
做得不错。
看来你已经适应这里了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Oh you're back.
Good job.
Now you are adapting.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
哦，你回来了。
做得不错。
看来你已经适应这里了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Um, did you like the supplies?
I like the red hat.
The red ribbon is really cute.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯，补给品还喜欢吗？
我喜欢那顶红帽子。
红色缎带也很可爱。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You finished the second step of training.
Now do you understand how this world is organized?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你完成了第二阶段训练。
现在明白这个世界的格局了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The training area is southwest of Morocc.
Enter the Saint Darmain Fortress to reach it directly.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
训练场在梦罗克西南方。
进入圣达梅因要塞就能直接抵达。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We serve trainees with equipment and armor after passing the second step of training.
Go to the storage and meet the person in charge there.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
通过第二阶段训练后，我们会给学员提供装备和护甲。
去仓库找负责人领取吧。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee there so you can use the Kafra services.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯，兽人村里有卡普拉职员，可以使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Hey long time no see.
So what's up?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好久不见。
最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee there so you can use the Kafra services there.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯，兽人村里有卡普拉职员，可以在那里使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Cool! You passed the third step of training.
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with some equipment.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
太棒了！你通过了第三阶段训练。
我会为你完成训练作记录。
去装备仓库找负责人领取装备吧。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
First take a ship toward to Bayalan from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
先从依斯鲁得岛乘船去巴亚兰！
那里有个地下洞窟。进去后一直往下走，最底层就是一座古老的海底城市。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
What do you want?
I doubt that you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你想做什么？
我看你应该不需要再训练了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
My boss created all the courses for the training.
After he manufactured the uniform and supplies he changed his mind and said that he can't give them for free.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
训练课程都是我老板设计的。
他把制服和补给品都准备好了，却突然改口说不能免费发给大家。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
[Boya]
If you finish all of the steps go and get your supplies.
We offer equipment to those who complete the training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
完成所有阶段后，就去领取补给品吧。
完成训练的人都能领取装备。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
What are you doing?
Get the equipment from the storage manager.
Our uniform is pretty awesome haha.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你在做什么？
去仓库找负责人领装备。
我们的制服可帅了，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The training area is at the north cave of Payon.
A staff member is already dispatched there.
Find him and follow his directions.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
训练场在斐扬北边的洞窟里。
我们已经派了一名工作人员过去。
去找他，听从他的安排。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
To register with the Eden Group ask Laime Evenor next to me.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
要加入伊甸园，请找我旁边的莱梅·伊维诺尔。

scripts.text: What is your responsibility?
scripts.translation: 你的职责是什么？

scripts.text: Don't you have equipment?
scripts.translation: 你没有装备吗？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I give training missions to members.
That's why they participate in it.
If they don't want to get in trouble, it's essential.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我会给队员安排训练任务。
所以他们才会参加训练。
想不惹麻烦，这些训练可少不了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Huh?
You are so honest!
Gosh. You wanted to know something about equipment?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
咦？
你还挺坦率的嘛！
天哪，你是想问装备的事吧？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Through battle training they can improve their real experience.
The members that prove themselves will even get a reward.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
通过实战训练，队员们可以积累实战经验。
表现出色的人还能得到奖励。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We gave them special equipmant that we have made.
These gifts are for people who are really doing their best.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我们给他们准备了特制装备。
这些是奖励给努力训练的队员的。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you are curious, you can join.
The training battle course is not very difficult.
There's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
感兴趣的话就加入吧。
战斗训练没那么难，
不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you want to join, don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
想加入的话就别犹豫。

scripts.text: Participate in the training.
scripts.translation: 参加训练

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Really? You already seem ready.
We have a total of 3 steps for the training.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
真的吗？看来你已经准备好了。
训练一共分为三个阶段。
我看看...

scripts.text:
[Boya]
It's all your decision.
It's not my business but you should probably reconsider.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
一切由你决定。
虽然不关我的事，不过你最好再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The first step is course A.
Course A is called 'Conquer the Desert!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我会安排你参加B课程的第一阶段。
课程名叫“征服下水道！”。
这项任务最适合你当前的等级。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I'll send you to the first step of course B.
Course B is called 'Conquer the Culvert!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation: [博雅]

scripts.text:
[Boya]
^4d4dffThere is a desert town called Morocc.
From there go south and then east. There is small oasis in the center of that field.^000000
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
^4d4dff有座沙漠城镇叫梦罗克。
从那里先往南，再往东走，那片平原中央有一座小绿洲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You need to register to explore the culvert in Prontera at the Knight Guild.
After registering there go to the western gate of Prontera. The manager of the culvert is near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
进入下水道后，你会遇到一只被派来的猫。
它会说话，别惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Once you enter the culvert you can find a dispatched cat. Don't be surprised if he talks to you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
进入下水道后，你会遇到一只被派来的猫。
它会说话，别惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you go there, you will find a dog around the oasis.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
去那里就能在绿洲附近看到一只狗。
它很神秘，还会说话，别吓着了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell the dog ^4d4dffBoya is really great.^000000
If you have any questions ask that dog.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告诉那只狗：^4d4dff“博雅真的很棒。”^000000
有问题也可以问它。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell the cat ^4d4dffBoya's help is like a giant and beautiful tuna^000000.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
He will give you a battle target when you tell him that.
If you have any questions ask the cat.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告诉那只猫：^4d4dff“博雅的帮助就像一条巨大又美丽的金枪鱼。”^000000
它很神秘，还会说话，别吓着了。
说出暗号后，它就会给你战斗目标。
有问题也可以问它。

scripts.text:

Why are you staring at me?
I had to come up with a password right?
What's wrong with that password?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之，那地方离这里不远，很适合你这样的新手。
去吧，愿芙蕾雅保佑你～！

scripts.text:

Why are you staring at me like that?
It's just a password that I made up.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之......
那地方离这里不远，很适合你这样的新手。
去吧，愿芙蕾雅保佑你～！

scripts.text:

Cool.
Let me choose a proper place for you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好。
我来给你挑个合适的训练地点。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I'll send you to the 2nd step of course B.
This course is called 'Conquer Anthell!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我会派你去完成B路线的第二阶段。
任务名为“征服蚂蚁地穴！”。
这项任务很适合你目前的等级。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You are on the third step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc village!'.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
这是A路线的第三阶段。
任务名为“征服兽人村！”。
我看看...

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You are on the last step.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ocean City!'.
I don't know if it is the proper course or not, but anyway it's the last course of our training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
这是最后一个阶段。
任务名为“征服海洋之都！”。
我不确定这项任务是否适合你，不过总之这是训练的最后一项。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You are on the third step of course B.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc dungeon!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
这是B路线的第三阶段。
任务名为“征服兽人地下洞窟！”。
这项任务很适合你目前的等级。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. You should raise your level more!
You need to be at least level 12!
I'm sorry but those are the rules.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
第一阶段是A课程。
课程名叫“征服沙漠！”。
这项任务最适合你当前的等级。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway, that place is not far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
要探索普隆德拉下水道，得先到骑士公会登记。
登记后去普隆德拉西门，下水道管理员就在入口附近。

scripts.text:

Anyway...
That place is nor far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好。
我来给你挑个合适的训练地点。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I'll send you to the second step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ghost Cave!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
斐扬北边有个小小的弓箭手村。
村子西边的山丘上有座洞窟。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Travel just southwest of Morocc City.
There you will find a hole in the ground to a cave called Anthell.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
里面有好多蚂蚁，懂吗？
洞里还覆满沙子，小心点，听见没有？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
There is a small archer village north of Payon.
There is a cave on the western hill of the archer village.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我们已经派人在洞窟前等你了。
他叫......呃......
......

scripts.text:
[Boya]
There are lots of ants in there. kk?
It is also covered in sand so be careful in there ok.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
里面有好多蚂蚁呢，嘿嘿？
里面还到处都是沙子，进去时小心点，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We have dispatched someone in front of the cave.
His name is... um...
...
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之，他是我们的人，认识我。
他会交给你任务。
有问题就问他。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
That's why it's called ant hell.
One of our members will be waiting there.
His name is... K? M? Hmm? Anyway I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
所以那地方才叫蚁穴。
我们有位队员会在那里等你。
他名字好像是......K？M？嗯？总之，我想不起来了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway he is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have questions ask him.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
干吗一直盯着我？
我们很久没见了，我才会想不起他的名字！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
He is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have any questions ask him.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
他是我们的人，认识我。
他会交给你任务。
有问题就问他。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me?
We haven't met for a long time that's why I can't remember his name!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之......
那地方离这里不远，快去快回。
去吧，愿芙蕾雅保佑你～！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway...
That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之......
那地方离这里不远，快去快回。
去吧，愿芙蕾雅保佑你～！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway...
That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.
Ok, blessing you~!!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之......
那地方离这里不远，快去快回。
去吧，愿芙蕾雅保佑你～！！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Go through the gate of Prontera and keep walking to the west. Orc Village is in that direction.
Or you can go out through the western gate of Geffen and keep heading southeast..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
穿过普隆德拉城门一直往西走，就能到兽人村。
也可以从吉芬西门出城，再一路往东南走......

scripts.text:
[Boya]
First take a ship to Byalan Island from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
先从依斯鲁得岛乘船前往巴亚兰岛！
那里有个地下洞窟。进去后一直走到最底层，就能找到古老的海底城市。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee dispatched there so you could use the Kafra services..
It's up to you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯，兽人村有卡普拉职员驻守，可以在那里使用卡普拉服务......
怎么走由你决定。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Although it's underwater, you can breath so don't worry.
There is a dispatched trainee around the entrance of the Ocean City.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
虽然在水下也能呼吸，放心吧。
海之都入口附近有一位我们派来的学员。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我们派去的队员在卡普拉职员附近的建筑里等你。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
She will explain what needs to be done there.
If you have any questions ask her.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
她会告诉你在那里要做什么。
有问题就问她。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell him that I sent you and follow his directions.
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告诉他是我派你来的，然后听从他的安排。
去吧，愿芙蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好，愿芙蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
I have a uniform set which is free for our group members.
But, I can't give it for free.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我这里有套制服，队员可以免费领取。
不过嘛，我可不会随便白送。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We give it to great participants who do their best in the training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
只有在训练中表现出色、全力以赴的人才配得上它。

scripts.text:
-Boya eyes you from top to bottom.
Hmm... he seems to think something is wrong.-
scripts.translation:
- 博雅从头到脚打量了你一番。
嗯......他似乎觉得哪里不太对。 -

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Due to emotion.

[博雅]
因为心情。

所以，你到底参不参加训练？

scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
那些盗虫旁边还有个脏东西。
去猎杀几只白鼠，让下水道干净些吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
For our members joining this mission.
Hunt 10 Tarou.
Easy, ain't it?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
既然加入了这项训练，
就去猎杀10只白鼠。
很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Why didn't I ask you at once? kkk..??
Umm........
Because it's just a training mission.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我怎么没早点问你呢？呵呵......？
嗯......
因为这只是训练任务嘛。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Training missions are hard and anoying.
So go hurry and hunt 10 Tarou.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
训练任务又难又烦。
所以快去猎杀10只白鼠吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Clean the sewers. Now the first step is hunting Thief Bugs.
Isn't that simple, meow?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
来清理下水道吧。第一步是猎杀盗虫。
很简单吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Take care to check your map so you don't get lost.
It's a service meeow.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
记得查看地图，免得迷路。
这是贴心服务，喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Great job~!
How'd you get rid of those dirty bugs and Tarou. You are brave.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
干得漂亮～！
你是怎么清除那些脏兮兮的盗虫和白鼠的？真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now have courage because I'm sending you to a stronger opponent.
But first in order to test your courage, hunt Familiars.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
鼓起勇气吧，我要派你去对付更强的对手。
不过在那之前，先猎杀使魔，测试一下你的胆量。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars will bite you so be careful.
They are mean.
They scare me so just hunt 5 and that should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
使魔会咬人，小心点。
它们可坏了。
我怕它们，所以猎杀5只就够了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
That will show me that you are brave.
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
这样就能证明你很勇敢了。
喵～！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I don't have anything...
......
What do you want meow? Familiars are waiting to fight with you, hurry up, move~!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我没什么要说的......
......
你还愣着干吗，喵？使魔正等着和你打呢。快去，动起来～！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
If you can't kill the Tarou you might get all kinds of dirty diseases.
So be proud of yourself and do your best to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
白鼠身上脏兮兮的，不赶紧消灭它们可能会染上各种病。
所以，为自己感到骄傲，好好努力把它们消灭吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我来帮你一点忙。
来，我帮你恢复体力了，喵......

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You are great meow~
You killed them so quickly!
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你真厉害，喵～
这么快就把它们消灭了！
喵......

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now you are not scared of bugs and tarou at all.
Thanks for participating in the Conquer the Culvert training mission.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
现在你已经一点也不怕盗虫和白鼠了。
感谢你参加“征服下水道”训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now go back to the headquarters and ask Instructor Boya to make sure he has the beautiful tuna...
I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
回总部去找教官博雅，让他确认那条美丽的金枪鱼还在......
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know how to get to the Eden Group Headquarters?
Prontera is the closest city from here.
Go to Prontera and find an Eden Group Teleporter.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你知道怎么去伊甸园总部吗？
离这里最近的城市是普隆德拉。
去那里找伊甸园传送师吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars are really scary.
They're always flying.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
使魔真的很可怕。
它们总是在天上飞。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's the last course so cheer up.
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
这是最后一项训练了，加油。
我来帮你一点忙。
来，我帮你恢复体力了，喵......

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You've completed 'Conquer the Culvert'.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters to report to Boya.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你完成了“征服下水道”训练。
回伊甸园总部向博雅报告吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Boya might eat my tuna while he is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
博雅等你的时候，说不定会把我的金枪鱼吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
How are you meeow?
Did you volunteer to conquer the Culvert?
You are a member of the Edgen Group for sure.
You are helping to make the world a better place.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你好呀，喵？
你自愿参加“征服下水道”训练了吗？
你肯定是伊甸园的成员。
你正在为让世界变得更美好而努力。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hey, how are you?
Good to see you~
Are you going inside?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嘿，最近怎么样？
见到你真高兴～
要进去吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Umm...?
You are not the one I am waiting for.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯......？
你不是我要等的人。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hello?
Since I got a report, I was waiting for you.
You came here to join the training mission, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你好？
我收到消息后就在这里等你了。
你是来参加训练任务的吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Have you ever entered this cave before?
I don't know if you already heard some stories in this village.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你以前进过这个洞窟吗？
不知道你有没有听村里的人说起过这里的传闻。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many of dead souls that change their appearance as if they are real people and make threatening remarks.
It's too bad, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
这里有许多亡魂，会伪装成活人，还会出言恐吓。
真让人头疼，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
That's why we chose this place as step 2 of the battle training mission.
This step is called 'Conquer Ghost Cave~'.
Help people to enjoy their nights comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
所以我们把这里选作战斗训练的第二阶段。
这一阶段叫“征服幽灵洞窟～”。
让大家夜里也能安心生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many dangerous things there. Hmm...
To you the 1st floor is enough.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
里面有不少危险的东西。嗯......
以你的实力，待在一楼就够了。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Lets conquer the dangerous ghost cave...
Kill the bone Skeletons in there.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
去征服这座危险的幽灵洞窟吧......
消灭里面的邪骸战士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
The bones are from Skeletons.
Actually Skeletons or just normal bones are all the same but...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
这些骨头都是邪骸战士留下的。
不过邪骸战士和普通骨头好像也没什么区别......

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are one of the basic undead classes.
Undead never ever. Hunt 15 undead Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
邪骸战士是最基础的亡灵之一。
不过亡灵可不会真正死去。去猎杀15只邪骸战士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If you feel like you're in danger don't hesitate to just leave.
You're not worried about getting hurt are you?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
觉得危险的话就别犹豫，直接撤退。
你不会是怕受伤吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get how the undead work?
As you know undead never die so, blessing of live person it's same as curse to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
明白亡灵的特性了吗？
如你所知，亡灵不会真正死去，所以活人的祝福对它们来说就像诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
So... skills which can save people like Heal and Resurrection.
Those things are really strong attacks to undead class.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
所以，能拯救活人的治愈术和复活术，
对亡灵来说反而是非常强力的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Anyway... that's it..
Next... I guess you already see while you were killing Skeletons.
Some green things are picking up all of the stuff dropped by the dead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
总之就是这样......
接下来，你猎杀邪骸战士时应该已经看到了：
有些绿色的东西正在捡走魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Do you know Porings? Maybe they are related to them.
They look really bad, maybe they have been eating poison or something.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你知道波利吧？那些东西或许和波利有关。
它们看起来状态很差，可能是吃了什么有毒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ok if you're ready go and kill those Poporings.
You should hunt 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
准备好了就去消灭那些变异波利吧。
猎杀10只。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are basic undead.
Use the Heal or Resurrection skill.
If you can.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
邪骸战士是基础的亡灵。
用治愈术或复活术攻击它们，
如果你会的话。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
以防万一，我先帮你恢复体力。
这是最后一步了，小心点。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get back what the Poporing stole?
This cave is really deep and there are lots of precious things that they could have picked up.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
拿回变异波利偷走的东西了吗？
这个洞窟很深，它们可能捡走了不少贵重物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You did really great job. Excellent.
The 1st floor is safer now. Thanks for helping.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你做得非常出色。太棒了。
一楼现在安全多了，多谢帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You've completed all of the training missions so go back to the headquarters and get approval from the flashy Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
训练任务全都完成了。回总部找那位闪亮的卢恩骑士确认吧。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You might get a new uniform.
Haha. I will keep tabs on your progression.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你可能会得到一套新制服。
哈哈，我会留意你的进步。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Poporings are stronger than you expect.
If you treat them the same as a normal Poring it will get you in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
要消灭亡灵吗？
尽力让这个世界更安全吧。
这也是伊甸园的目标之一。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
以防万一，我先帮你恢复体力。
这是最后一步了，小心点。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I already informed Boya at the Eden Group headquarters.
If you go there he will give you a big welcome.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
这里有只非常强大的首领魔物。
探索时要小心。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You will get a new uniform, aren't you excited?
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你看什么？
我们又没有关系......

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Killing undead?
Do your best to make the world safer.
It's one of the goals of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你好？
怎么跑到这里来了？想找危险吗？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oops.
You are a member of my group.
Why did you come here, are you looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
征服蚁穴

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
One of the strongest boss monsters is in here.
Be careful when exploring here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
只是想见见你

scripts.text:
[Cloud ]
What are you looking at?
We are not related to each other, are we...
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
我在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hello?
Why did you come here, looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
嗯？你说要“征服蚁穴”？
你是来参加训练的学员啊。
那你来对地方了。

scripts.text: Conquer Ant Hell
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
先给你介绍一下蚁穴。
蚂蚁在沙地里挖出洞穴，直通地表，这就是蚁穴。

scripts.text: Just wanted to meet you
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
沙子会一点点灌进洞里。
有人踩上去，就会从沙面上的洞口掉进蚁穴......

scripts.text: Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
掉进去可不容易活着出来。
不过对我们来说，这种事很平常，所以也谈不上什么生死关头。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Uh. Conquer Ant Hell? Did you say that?
You are a trainee.
You have come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
各种蚂蚁都搬来这里住了。
里面还有只叫蚁后的首领魔物，千万要小心。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
At first I will explain about Ant Hell.
Ants dug a cave in the sand and it is linked to the surface. That's Ant Hell.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
好，先试着猎杀最弱的蚂蚁。
最弱的叫白蚁。
就在下面。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Sand flowed into the hole gradually.
If anyone steps on the hole they will fall into the cave through the hole in the sand..
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
蚂蚁遭到攻击时会互相支援。
小心应对，猎杀15只白蚁。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's hard to survive from there.
To us it seems like a normal happening so it isn't a matter of survival like to normal people.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
......
哈哈......你在开玩笑吧？
沙漠天气这么热，你都累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Many kinds of ants have come to live here.
There is a boss monster named Maya so you should be more cautious.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
我可是很忙的。
有个学员说要来找我，到现在还没出现，真让人着急。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ok let's try to hunt the weakest ant first.
Pierre is the name of the weakest ant.
They are just down here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
好，先猎杀最弱的蚂蚁。
它叫白蚁。
就在下面。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
In the case of ants, they assist eachother when attacked.
Be careful and kill 15 Pierre ants.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
蚂蚁遇袭时会互相支援。
小心应对，猎杀15只白蚁。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
......
Haha... are you joking?
You are exhausted from the extremely hot weather in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
......
哈哈......你在开玩笑吧？
沙漠天气热得让你精疲力尽了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am a busy man.
One of the trainees was planning to visit me but that person still hasn't showed yet. I am getting nervous.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
我可是很忙的。
有个学员说要来找我，却一直没出现，我都等得着急了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Where you are?
You are in Anth Hell southwest of Morocc.
Morocc is the closest city, northeast of here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你现在在哪里？
你在梦罗克西南方的蚁穴里。
离这里最近的城市是东北方的梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, what was it?
Maybe you saw an Andre when you were hunting Pierre.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
嘿，怎么了？
你猎杀白蚁时应该看到变异芯片了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Well, now let's hunt Andre aswel.
Ahah the way you're looking at me, ''why didn't I ask you to do this all at once'' right?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
好吧，那现在也去猎杀变异芯片。
哈哈，看你这眼神，是不是在想：“为什么不一开始就一起交代？”

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ain't it more fun this way?
Hey, now your next target is 15 Andre!
You are strong so it will be fine!
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
这样不是更有趣吗？
下一个目标是15只变异芯片！
你这么强，一定没问题！

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you can't find Andre go deeper into the cave.
Ah, and be careful of Maya.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
找不到变异芯片的话，就往洞窟深处走。
还有，小心蚁后。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
What do you think of Ant Hell?
Can you stay longer?
Ok, I will recover your strengh so, keep going.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
觉得蚁穴怎么样？
还能继续坚持吗？
好，我帮你恢复体力，继续加油。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Great. You seem to have killed all of the Andre.
How do you think about fighting ants?
Was it good?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
很好，看来你已经消灭了所有变异芯片。
和蚂蚁战斗感觉怎么样？
还不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, cheer up.
To conquer Ant Hell you have one step left.
You might have guessed your next target already.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
嘿，打起精神来。
征服蚁穴只剩最后一步了。
你应该已经猜到下一个目标了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Vitata!
How can I say... He seems like honey.
Pierre is a worker. Andre is a guardian and so... Vitata is like a mother.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
黑蚁！
该怎么说呢......它们像是蚁穴里的蜂蜜。
白蚁是工蚁，变异芯片是卫兵......那么黑蚁就像母亲。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
They are really kind to kids and women but don't show any pity to ants.
Hunt the Vitata who takes care of the ant eggs.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
它们对幼蚁和蚁后照顾有加，但对其他蚂蚁可不会手下留情。
去猎杀负责照料蚁卵的黑蚁。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If somebody falls into Ant Hell it might be a bit safer than before.
Now it's the last step so cheer up and let's kill 10 Vitata.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
有人掉进蚁穴时，至少现在会安全些了。
最后一步了，打起精神来，去猎杀10只黑蚁。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you feel you're in too much danger. Just come back.
I will heal you.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
觉得太危险的话就回来，我会帮你治疗。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer you up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
看，为了让你坚持到训练结束，我会一直帮你治疗。
抬起头，振作起来。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oh... it might have been an anoying fight.
You finished so fast.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
哦......这场战斗可能挺烦人的吧。
不过你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Good job. Go back to the headquarters and report.
You've completed the training quickly.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
干得好。回总部汇报吧。
你很快就完成了训练。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
You will get good news.
You did a really good job even under the hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
有好消息等着你。
这么热的天气里，你还完成得这么出色。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
看，为了让你坚持到训练结束，我会一直帮你治疗。
抬起头，振作起来。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Just Vitata, isn't that an easy opponent?
If you see Maya just run away.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
就对付黑蚁而已，不算难吧？
看到蚁后就赶快逃。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's enough to say that you've conquered Ant Hell.
Aren't you getting used to it here?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
可以说你已经征服蚁穴了。
你也渐渐习惯这里了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Go back to the headquarters and report that you completed the mission, hurry up
you will receive good news.
You will receive the Eden Group uniform aswel.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
赶快回总部报告任务完成。
你会收到好消息，
还有一套伊甸园制服。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am really proud of the Eden Group.
Does the uniform look good on me?
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
我真的为伊甸园感到骄傲。
这套制服穿在我身上好看吗？
哈哈......

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Unbelievable why did you come here?
Um... You are not on the third step of the training?
Yeeee~ I'm excited~
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
真难以置信，你怎么跑到这里来了？
嗯......你不是该在训练第三阶段吗？
耶～我好兴奋～

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
I am a little bored waiting for trainees. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
等学员等得有点无聊了。他们人呢？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Why did you come here?
Umm... Aaaaa...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你怎么来这里了？
嗯......啊啊......

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Why don't you join my group?
If you have interest in joining us,
you won't regret your decision.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
要不要加入我的小队？
如果你有兴趣加入，
保证不会后悔。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Are you a trainee?
Yeah I can tell.
So shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你是来参加训练的学员吗？
我一看就知道了。
那我们开始吧？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Actually I don't like this training mission much but anyway let me explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
其实我不太喜欢这项训练，不过还是先给你说明一下。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
As you know this is Orc Village.
Orcs don't like humans.
They don't try to communicate with us. When they see humans they immediately attack us.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你知道的，这里是兽人村。
兽人不喜欢人类，
也不愿意和我们交流，一看到人就会立刻攻击。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Sadly humans don't want to communicate with them either.
So we decided to take a strong approach towards them.
Actually we'd like to get rid of them all.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
遗憾的是，人类也不想和他们沟通。
所以我们决定采取强硬手段。
说实话，我们想把他们全部消灭。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
We're trying to conquer Orc Village.
It's the proper place to finish the beginners training mission for an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
我们正在攻占兽人村。
对你这样的冒险者来说，这里正适合完成新手训练。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
That's why we've chosen this place for this mission.
Ok, we don't have a lot of time so let's begin.
First let's eliminate the weakest one.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
所以我们选了这里作为训练地点。
时间不多，开始吧。
先消灭最弱的目标。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's better to kill them before they grow up.
Hunt 10 Orc Babies.
Don't pity them because when they grow up they become aggressive Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
趁它们还没长大，最好先下手。
猎杀10只兽人婴儿。
别心软，它们长大后会变成凶悍的兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Good or bad this is how it is going to be.
Even if they are babies don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不管你觉得对不对，事情就是这样。
即使它们还是婴儿，也别犹豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great. Awesome.
It's not very pleasant so let's move on.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
很好，干得漂亮。
这活儿不怎么愉快，继续吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
On the next step we will fight with Orc Warriors.
When Orc Babies grow up they become strong Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
下一阶段要对付兽人战士。
兽人婴儿长大后就会变成强壮的兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They all are powerful warriors.
When you were fighting Orc Babies, you probably have been attacked by them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它们都是强悍的战士。
你猎杀兽人婴儿时，应该已经遭到它们攻击了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now it's time to hunt 10 Orc Warriors.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
现在去猎杀10只兽人战士。
遇到危险就回来这里避难。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
There are Orc Warriors, Orc Ladies and Orc Babies in Orc Village.
They are really aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
兽人村里有兽人战士、兽人女士和兽人婴儿。
它们都很凶猛。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起来累了，我来帮你恢复体力。
遇到危险就回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now you can move on to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
现在可以进入下一阶段了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Exactly... now it's time to hunt Orc Ladies.
If you want to conquer Orc Village completely, you should kill them before they have more Orc Babies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
没错......现在该去猎杀兽人女士了。
想彻底攻下兽人村，就得在她们生出更多兽人婴儿前行动。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
But you don't need to kill all of them.
Go and hunt 10 Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不过不用赶尽杀绝。
去猎杀10只兽人女士就行。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You can already feel the strong power from outside...
Don't hesitate to attack them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你已经感受到外面那股强大的气息了吧......
别犹豫，主动攻击。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You should be exhausted by now.
But you still have more targets, understand.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你现在应该累坏了。
不过还有更多目标，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起来累了，我来帮你恢复体力。
遇到危险就回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great job.
Now you should understand how the orc tribe works here in Orc Village.
You've followed the training mission well under hot and humid circumstances.
You have now completed the 'Conquer Orc Village!' training mission. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
干得好。
现在你应该了解兽人村里兽人部族的情况了。
你在又热又潮湿的环境下顺利完成了训练。
“征服兽人村！”训练任务完成，恭喜。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Go back and report to the Eden Group headquarters.
I'm sure they will have good news for you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
回伊甸园总部报告吧。
我想他们会给你带来好消息。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Orc Lady is the last target.
Cheer up~!
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
兽人女士是最后一个目标。
加油～！

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起来累了，我来帮你恢复体力。
遇到危险就回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You have completed the training mission.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
训练任务完成了。
回伊甸园总部报告吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Have you come here to join in the training?
You look like an expert.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你是来参加训练的吗？
看起来像是个老手。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This isn't a good place to talk so let's hurry.
This place is linked with the dungeon of Orc Village.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这里不适合聊天，快走吧。
这里连着兽人村地下洞窟。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you see that way.
There is a cave under the ground, normal orcs don't come here.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
看到那边了吗？
地下有个洞窟，普通兽人不会来这里。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The safest place is in here.
There are many undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这里是最安全的地方。
下面有很多不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The undead monsters are dangerous and threatening.
Don't hesitate when fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不死系魔物既危险又凶猛。
战斗时别犹豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now hunt those undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
现在去猎杀下面的不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Try to hunt 20 Orc zombies in the dungeon.
They are really well organized.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
去地下洞窟猎杀20只兽人腐尸。
它们配合得相当有组织。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They will attack you anywhere without hesitating.
May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它们无论在哪里都会毫不犹豫地攻击你。
愿芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's different from what you saw in Payon, right?
Although you managed to kill the Orc Zombies, you can't be sure you are much stronger..
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
和你在斐扬见到的情况不同吧？
虽然你杀死了兽人腐尸，但还不能掉以轻心......

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
So don't go deeper into that cave or you will die for sure.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
别再深入洞窟了，否则肯定会丧命。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The next target is the Orc Skeleton who was walking next to the Orc Zombies.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
下一个目标是兽人腐尸旁边徘徊的邪骸兽人。
猎杀20只邪骸兽人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's the last step of the training mission in the Orc Dungeon.
It's all up to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这是兽人地下城训练任务的最后一步。
接下来就看你的了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Ok, cheer up and see you again.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
好，打起精神来，回头见。
记得猎杀20只邪骸兽人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
还能坚持吗？
你看起来累了，我来帮你恢复体力。
遇到危险就回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Your training mission has been completed.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report.
I would like to say more in detail but I'm getting so tired.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
训练任务完成了。
回伊甸园总部报告吧。
我本想再详细说说，不过已经累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Recently trainees have come here more and more so, I can't sleep at all.
I mean not due to you.
Anyway I will inform the group so go there and report.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
最近来这里的学员越来越多，我都睡不好了。
不是在怪你哦。
总之我会通知总部，你回去报告吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
还能坚持吗？
你看起来累了，我来帮你恢复体力。
遇到危险就回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Don't you have to report back to the Eden Group headquarters?
I am so tired leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你不该回伊甸园总部报告了吗？
我累坏了，别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Uh? What Orc? Explore the dungeon?
You are having such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
嗯？什么兽人？探索地下城？
你也太辛苦了吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This place is really good to take a rest because Orcs don't come here.
Ho hum...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这里很适合休息，兽人不会来。
哈啊......

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
你怎么深入海之都到这里来了？
啊，那个标志是我们小队的。
你肯定是来受训的吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
What? You aren't?
I... see... I see...
Ok... keep going.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
什么？你不是？
我......明白了......
好吧......继续走吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
奇怪的是，我们明明在海底，却能在这里呼吸。
你知道为什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Let's see due to the moisture my skin is so soft.
My fingers and toes are not attached to each other amazing.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
潮湿的环境让我的皮肤变得很柔软。
而且我的手指和脚趾居然没有连在一起，真神奇。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
I was really shocked and scared when the Eden Group dispatched me here.
Now I love this environment so much.
It's really calm...
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
伊甸园把我派来时，我既震惊又害怕。
现在我却很喜欢这里的环境。
这里真的很宁静......

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
你怎么深入海之都到这里来了？
啊，那个标志是我们小队的。
你肯定是来受训的吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Good to see you!
Alright, look down.
Ancient buildings are sleeping under the water. They were actually built under the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
很高兴见到你！
来，往下看。
古老的建筑沉睡在海底，它们原本就是建在水下的。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
As you know we don't have any trouble living here.
But if you see over there... yes right there.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
我们在这里生活得很自在。
不过你看那边......对，就是那里。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Can you see a humanoid fish with a very threatening spear?
He is called a Merman and is a really professional warrior.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
看到那个拿着危险长矛的人形鱼了吗？
那是人鱼士兵，是非常专业的战士。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Okay, go and hunt 15 Merman.
That will be your 1st training mission here.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
好，去猎杀15个人鱼士兵。
这是你在这里的第一项训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh, you came back~!
What did you think of those threatening Mermans?
Actually, I thought that you would chicken out~
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
哦，你回来了～！
那些人鱼士兵怎么样？
说真的，我还以为你会吓得临阵脱逃呢～

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Good your next opponent will be...~
Yes, this one...
The monster that is holding a trident.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
很好，下一个对手是......～
没错，就是它......
那只拿着三叉戟的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
His main abilities are magical.
The monster is called Strouf!
Now, it's time to fight with a real magician!
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
它主要擅长魔法。
这只魔物叫海神！
现在来和真正的魔法师交手吧！

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Try avoiding the Mermans and hunt 10 Strouf, kill them.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
尽量避开人鱼士兵，猎杀10只海神。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh are you tired?
Mermans are not easy opponents.
I will help you recover so cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
累了吗？
人鱼士兵可不好对付。
我来帮你恢复体力，打起精神来。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Did you kill all the Strouf already?
I wasn't counting that you'd make it.
I have eyes on the top of my head haha.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
已经把海神都消灭了吗？
我还真没想到你能做到。
看来我真是看走眼了，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Of course I'm just kidding.
Don't look at me like that~ it was a joke~!
Now you're feeling more at ease about this.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
我当然是在开玩笑。
别那样看我嘛～只是开个玩笑～！
这样你应该放松些了吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Go back to the headquarters and report it.~
You will receive the last uniform from the Eden Group headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
回总部报告吧～
你会从伊甸园总部领取最后一套制服。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
This training mission is made for beginners.
So it might be useless to you or not.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
这项训练任务是为新手准备的，
对你来说可能没什么帮助。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Anyway you did great job!
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
总之，你做得非常出色！

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh are you tired?
Strouf are not easy opponents.
I can help you recover so cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
累了吗？
海神可不好对付。
我来帮你恢复体力，打起精神来。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
I won't give help to you anymore.
Go back to our headquarters and report about this training mission.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
我不会再帮你恢复了。
回总部报告这次训练任务吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
奇怪的是，我们明明在海底，却能在这里呼吸。
你知道为什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Let's see due to the moisture my skin is so soft.
My fingers and toes are not attached to each other amazing.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
潮湿的环境让我的皮肤变得很柔软。
而且我的手指和脚趾居然没有连在一起，真神奇。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
I was really shocked and scared when the Eden Group dispatched me here.
Now I love this environment so much.
It's really calm...
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
伊甸园把我派来时，我既震惊又害怕。
现在我却很喜欢这里的环境。
这里真的很宁静......

scripts.text:
[Michael]
Why did you come here?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔]
你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: To get supplies
scripts.translation: 领取补给

scripts.text: Where is here?
scripts.translation: 这里是什么地方？

scripts.text: Upgrade equipment
scripts.translation: 升级装备

scripts.text:
[Michael]
We store weapons, armor and other goods which were created by the Eden Group here.
We also have a lot of special stuff.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔]
这里存放着伊甸园制作的武器、防具和其他物品。
还有不少特别的装备。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
You mean upgrading equipment, right?
We can only upgrade the Eden Group Hat.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔]
你是想升级装备吧？
我们这里只能升级伊甸园圆帽。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
If you've completed step 2, we offer extra weapons including the basic equipment.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔]
如果你完成了第二阶段，除了基础装备外，还可以领取额外武器。

scripts.text:
[Michael]
If you've completed step 1
we can supply you with a Eden Group Hat, Uniform, Manteau and Boots.

scripts.translation:
[厨师]
没什么，很可爱。
我只是有点在意那条缎带。
不过我确实得戴着这顶帽子......

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Hahahah I don't care.
I don't care at all!
Hahaha.. aaaahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
哈哈哈，我不在乎。
一点也不在乎！
哈哈......啊哈哈哈......

scripts.text:
[Chef]
He is a knife expert.
One of our guard leaders.
Who is also in charge of the security in this office.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
他是用刀的高手，
也是卫队长之一，
还负责办公室的安全。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Almost everyone just hired wonders about him.
But Laime and Luke are totally different.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
几乎每个新来的员工都会对他感到好奇。
不过莱姆和卢克可完全不一样。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
The leaders have worked together for a long time.
But the leader wants to hide his past...
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
几位负责人共事很久了。
不过那位负责人似乎想隐瞒自己的过去......

scripts.text:
[Chef]
What I guess is... he might be a son of a rich family.
Rumor is that Luke was the family guard.
Laime was a servant? Wasn't she?
What do you think about my story?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我猜......他可能出身富裕人家。
听说卢克曾是他家的护卫，
莱姆是仆人？是这样吧？
你觉得我猜得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
............
Ahah..hey~ even if I talked useless things don't look at me like that
but it's really true that three people established this Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
......
啊哈......喂～就算我说了些没用的话，也别那样看我嘛。
不过伊甸园确实是由三个人创立的。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Uh? Missions. Did you find the right place?
Also let me se... you are not one of our members. How can I give you work?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
嗯？任务？你找对地方了吗？
我看看......你不是我们的人啊。我怎么能给你派任务？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Just eat in the restaurant.
We serve meals to everyone.
I am pretty sure they taste great!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
去餐厅吃饭吧。
我们对所有人开放供餐。
味道绝对不错！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hey there!
I see you're not one of our agents?
Are you interested in joining us?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
你好！
看起来你还不是我们的成员？
有兴趣加入吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Oh, there he is.
Romeo seems to be back from his field report.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
哦，他回来了。
罗密欧似乎刚做完外勤汇报。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hello?
Do you need help?
This is a general request in order to receive the next board's request.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
你好？
需要帮忙吗？
这是领取下一块公告板任务前必须完成的一般委托。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hey, buddy~
What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嘿，伙计～
最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Oh! You're here!
I just got a message from Johan.
I think he's not telling me something, but I can't figure out what that is.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
哦！你来了！
我刚收到约翰的消息。
我觉得他有事瞒着我，可就是猜不出来是什么。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ah, ever so improving {0}?
To what do I owe this pleasure?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
哟，越来越厉害了嘛，{0}？
今天怎么有空来找我？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
It's nice to see you still strong!
What brings you today?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
你还是这么精神，真好！
今天来做什么？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ah, you've come.
I just received a message from Kiren.
How was he? He didn't throw a tantrum for waking him up?
I wouldn't be surprised if he did
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
啊，你来了。
我刚收到基伦的消息。
他怎么样？叫醒他时没发脾气吧？
要是发了，我也不意外。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Congratulations on completing all training stages!
How was the Expedition? From the looks of it, it must've been pretty tough.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
恭喜你完成所有训练阶段！
远征怎么样？看你的样子，过程一定很艰苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Congratulations on completing all training stages!
That took quite a bit of time huh?
The Blacksmith BK said he'll reinforce your weapon.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
恭喜你完成所有训练阶段！
花了不少时间吧？
铁匠BK说要帮你强化武器。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Good job.
Oh, if you haven't reinforced your weapon yet, go talk to BK.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
干得好。
哦，还没强化武器的话，就去找BK。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
2nd stage training missions start at level 70.
I'll see you then.
Did you pick up the necessary equipment from the storage?
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
第二阶段训练要到70级才开放。
到时候再见。
仓库里该领的装备都拿了吗？
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
3rd stage training starts at level 80.
I'll see you then.
Oh, if you haven't reinforced your weapon yet, go talk to BK.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
第三阶段训练要到80级才开放。
到时候再见。
还没强化武器的话，就去找BK。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
4th stage training starts at level 90.
I'll see you then.
Oh, if you haven't reinforced your weapon yet, go talk to BK.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
第四阶段训练要到90级才开放。
到时候再见。
还没强化武器的话，就去找BK。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
So, have you been in ^4d4dffComodo^000000 yet?
Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那么，你去过^4d4dff梦罗克^000000了吗？
我不是让你去那里吗？
先去一趟，再回来找我。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
So, have you been in ^4d4dffGlast Heim Castle^000000 yet?
Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那么，你去过^4d4dff古城^000000了吗？
我不是让你去那里吗？
先去一趟，再回来找我。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
So, have you been in ^4d4dffEinbroch^000000 yet?
Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那么，你去过^4d4dff艾音布罗克^000000了吗？
我不是让你去那里吗？
先去一趟，再回来找我。好吗？

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]
scripts.translation: [指导员乌尔]

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
So, have you been in ^4d4dffIce Dungeon^000000 yet?
Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那么，你去过^4d4dff冰洞^000000了吗？
我不是让你去那里吗？
先去一趟，再回来找我。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
You have to travel very far to get to the ^4d4dffMidgard Expedition Camp^000000!
If you want to stay there then earn your keep by doing missions. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
^4d4dff米德加尔特远征营地^000000很远！
想留在那里，就靠完成任务养活自己，懂了吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There are no fees to join!
We are brokers that send help where help is needed. More adventurers like you means more profit.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
加入完全免费！
我们会把援助送到需要帮助的地方。像你这样的冒险者越多，我们赚得也越多。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
If you're interested, talk to Raim.
Raim's a good guy.
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
有兴趣的话就去找莱姆。
莱姆人不错。
哈哈哈......

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: It's nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I guess I have no business with you then.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那我想我们没什么可谈的了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, I'm an instructor for Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嗯，我是伊甸园的指导员。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I'm here to give you missions based on your current base level.
These missions are not very difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
我会根据你的基础等级安排任务。
这些任务都不难。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I am the senior instructor here at Eden Group.
What do you say are you up for the challenge?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
我是伊甸园的资深指导员。
怎么样，敢接受挑战吗？

scripts.text: Not today I'm not.
scripts.translation: 今天还是算了。

scripts.text: Okay, I'll try.
scripts.translation: 好，我试试看。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Really?
That's so sad.
When you finish these missions I will even give you a pretty decent reward.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
真的吗？
太遗憾了。
完成这些任务后，我还会给你相当不错的奖励呢。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Yeah!
Ok, let me check what mission you should get ok?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
太好了！
我看看该给你安排什么任务。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well... I know that you've got the heart but you're just a little too weak to help.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嗯......我知道你有这份心，可惜你现在实力还不够，帮不上忙。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ok, I guess you're the bare minimum level for these missions.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
好吧，你刚好达到这些任务的最低等级要求。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, well...
I don't even know where to send you now.
I'm sure you are familiar with most places around here
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
哎呀...
我都不知道该派你去哪里了。
我想你对附近大多数地方都很熟悉了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Uh-huh....
Hmm...
You seem like a cool-headed person. What do you think about the ice caves?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嗯...
让我想想...
你看起来很冷静。你觉得冰窟怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ah, ok so for you...
Hmm where do I send you?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
啊，好吧，适合你的任务......
嗯，该派你去哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Let's see...
Your level would suggest that Comodo is just too easy for you.
Yeah, here we go.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
我看看......
以你的等级，克魔岛的任务太简单了。
对了，就这个。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Sorry, but your basic level should be at least 60 to help with these missions.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
抱歉，基础等级至少要达到60级，才能参加这些任务。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Based on your level, I think that the Comodo area suits you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
按你的等级，克魔岛一带应该很适合你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where Comodo is?
You can get there by going to Morocc and then through Pharos Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
你知道克魔岛在哪儿吗？
先到梦罗克，再经过灯塔岛就能抵达。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Comodo is a small city on the coast with many caves.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
克魔岛是海岸边的一座小城，周围有许多洞窟。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Look for the cave located to the north. There's someone there named Romeo.
You know? As in Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
去北边的洞窟找一个叫罗密欧的人。
知道莎士比亚那句台词吧？“罗密欧，罗密欧，你在哪里？”

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Go there are get the mission from him.
Well, then come back here alive when you're done!
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
去找他接任务。
办完后记得活着回来！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where Glast Heim is?
If there was a tragic accident now, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom could revert back to there.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
你知道格拉斯特海姆在哪儿吗？
那里曾是卢恩米德加兹王国的首都。要是现在发生什么悲剧，首都说不定又会迁回那里。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, if it wasn't infested with undead monsters, it would become the new capitol of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
要不是亡灵魔物横行，格拉斯特海姆早就成了卢恩米德加兹的新首都。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Please, come back alive.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
一定要活着回来。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There an industrial city called Einbroch.
You know it? It's a city covered in smog.
It's a pretty gloomy city come to think of it.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那边有座工业城市叫艾音布罗克。
你知道吧？整座城都笼罩在烟雾里。
想想还真是个阴沉的地方。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, go to Einbroch and find the Dispatched Instructor there. He should be in the field south of the main city.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
总之，去艾音布罗克找派遣指导员。他应该在主城南边的野外。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Then, should I send you somewhere farther this time?
There is a Cat Paw Agent here.
Do you see him over there?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那这次派你去远一点的地方如何？
这里有位猫爪特派员。
看到那边那位了吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Through him, you can get to Ash Vacuum pretty easily .
Since there is a Expedition Camp there...
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
通过他就能轻松前往异世界。
远征营地就在那边......

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
All you have to do is find the Eden Group agent there.
Tell him I sent you, and he'll give you instructions.
You can explore the new world
It's like a vacation isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
找到那里的伊甸园特派员就行。
告诉他是我派你去的，他会给你指示。
你还能顺便探索新世界，
就当是度假吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hahaha!
.. Maybe I'll go instead of sending you.
Anyways, their names are Ma~ something... I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
哈哈哈！
......说不定我会自己去，不派你去了。
总之，他们的名字好像是“玛～”什么的，我也记不清了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
North of the city of Rachel is a cave filled with ice.
Find the Dispatched Instructor there.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
拉赫城北边有个冰雪覆盖的洞窟。
去那里找派遣指导员。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
So, the mission, once again, is finding our agent at the Midgard Expedition Camp.
Isn't this the easiest mission you've ever had?
Don't forget my present when you come back~!
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
再说一次，任务就是去米德加尔特远征营地找我们的特派员。
这大概是你做过最简单的任务吧？
回来时别忘了给我带礼物～！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
We have rewards for you.
I'm sure Romeo gave you some items, but we brought more useful things.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
我们给你准备了奖励。
罗密欧应该给过你一些东西，不过我们这边还有更实用的装备。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where the weapon storage is at?
Go out through that large blue door and walk to the end of the hallway.
Ask the Blacksmith, and he will give you new equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
知道武器仓库在哪儿吗？
穿过那扇大蓝门，走到走廊尽头。
找铁匠领取新装备。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
And the 2nd stage training and missions start at level 70, so come back then.
Don't forget, I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
第二阶段训练和任务要到70级才开放，到时候再来。
别忘了，我会等着你。

scripts.text: I want to start training.
scripts.translation: 开始训练。

scripts.text: I'm just visiting.
scripts.translation: 我只是来看看。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hmm... You have a good form!
Let me see....
Which location would suit you...?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嗯......状态不错嘛！
让我看看......
哪个地点适合你呢？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Really? At your level, I think you can easily complete the top class missions..
I'll be here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
真的吗？以你的等级，最高阶任务应该轻轻松松。
改主意的话，我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, well...
I don't even know where to send you now.
I'm sure you are familiar with most places around here
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
哎呀...
我都不知道该派你去哪里了。
我想你对附近大多数地方都很熟悉了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Uh-huh....
Hmm...
You seem like a cool-headed person. What do you think about the ice caves?
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嗯...
让我想想...
你看起来很冷静。你觉得冰窟怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hmm.. Not bad ...
You must be getting a hang of this..
Let's go with a simple mission this time
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
嗯...不错...
你应该已经渐渐上手了...
这次来个简单的任务吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ah, this place should be good!
Do you know where Glast Heim is?
If it wasn't for that terrible accident, Glast Heim would still be
the capital of Rune-Midgarts, not Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
啊，这个地方不错！
你知道格拉斯特海姆在哪儿吗？
要不是那场可怕的灾难，格拉斯特海姆如今仍会是卢恩米德加兹的首都，而不是普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, that ancient castle is now full of undead monsters .
It's especially bad around the Abbey in the south.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
总之，那座古堡如今遍布亡灵魔物。
南边修道院附近尤其严重。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
All of those undead monsters come from the underground graveyard
Well... I guess you don't have to go all the way into the graveyard...
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
那些亡灵魔物都来自地下墓地。
不过......你应该不用一路深入墓地。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Once you get to the Abbey you'll see our unit member stationed in front of the entrance.
Follow his instructions to help clear out that area.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
到修道院后，你会看到我们的队员守在入口处。
听从他的指示，协助清理周围区域。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Please come back alive.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
一定要活着回来。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There is a industrial city called Einbroch.
You've heard of it? It's a city clouded with pollution.
You'll appreciate the environment here so much more after visiting that city...
We should all be thankful.
scripts.translation:
[指导员乌尔]
有座工业城市叫艾音布罗克。
听说过吗？那里被污染的烟雾笼罩。
去过那里后，你一定会更珍惜这里的环境......大家都该心怀感激。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]

[Romeo]

Comodo has the best weather in the whole world.
Even during the winter, Comodo has great weather.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
最近怎么样？
克魔岛的天气是全世界最好的。
就算冬天，天气也很舒服。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
How are you?
You were sent here by Instructor Ur right?
Did you come here for a quest?
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
最近怎么样？
你是乌尔指导员派来的吧？
是来接任务的吗？

scripts.text:

You've fought these before, so clearing this cave should be possible.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
你现在的探索能力怎么样？
这些魔物你以前对付过，清理这个洞窟应该没问题。

scripts.text:

As a test of the difficulty of this cave
Go defeat 3 Stalactic Golems.
Watch out for other monsters as well.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
先来测试一下这座洞窟的难度。
去击败3只钟乳巨石怪。
也要小心其他魔物。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I always give the same test to the trainees that come here..
I've never seen anyone pass it so perfectly like you did.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
我给来这里的学员出的都是同一项测试......
可从没见过有人像你一样轻松漂亮地完成。

scripts.text:

Don't forget to defeat the Stalactic Golems you run into on the way.
scripts.translation:

路上遇到钟乳巨石怪，别忘了击败它们。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

This area is a place for relaxation.
scripts.translation:

这里就是用来休息的地方。

scripts.text:

I don't know if this will fit you well
Why don't you just try it.

不如试试看。

scripts.text:

If you stay cautious, they shouldn't be too threatning...

scripts.translation:

而且有时还会有特别强的家伙在附近游荡。

scripts.text:

Let's try taking on one of the big monsters
scripts.translation:

这就是训练的意义嘛，对吧？

scripts.text:

Not too difficult, right?

它们叫钟乳巨石怪。

不算太难吧？

scripts.text:

Access to the outside world is mostly done through the east entrance, but...
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
正如我刚才说的，克魔岛是一座洞窟里的城市......
平时主要从东边的出口通往外界，不过......

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
