scripts.text:
[Romeo]
No no.. Not here.
I'm waiting for a different trainee right now.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
不，不是这里。
我现在在等另一位学员。
回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Ugh, It's way too hot here.
You can leave now.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
唉，这里热得受不了。
你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Now look around here
We're in a dense forest now.
There are Dryads and Wootans here...
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
看看周围。
我们现在身处茂密的森林。
这里有森林妖姬和伍坦战士......

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Next task is to clearing this area of monsters.
Bring me the following from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
接下来要清理这一带的魔物。
从它们身上收集以下物品交给我。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
5 Wootan Fighter's Shoulderguard
7 Dryad's Sharp Leaf
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
5个伍坦战士护肩
7片森林妖姬的尖叶

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
This is the last test.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
这是最后一项测试。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
累了的话，我可以帮你恢复体力。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
There are no more training tasks here.
Go back and report to Ur.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
这里的训练任务已经全部完成。
回去向乌尔报告吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
5 Wootan Fighter's Shoulderguard
7 Dryad's Sharp Leaf
You must bring me those to pass this test.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
5个伍坦战士护肩
7片森林妖姬的尖叶
带齐这些物品才能通过测试。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
累了的话，我可以帮你恢复体力。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Ah~ So bored.
You're not the one Ur sent, are you?
Oh~ That's okay.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
啊～真无聊。
你不是乌尔派来的人吧？
哦～没关系。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Oh oh!!
You're finally here!
I asked Ur to send someone to help me here!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
哦哦！！
你终于来了！
我拜托乌尔派人来帮我！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Ugh, I still haven't found the thing I lost.
Hmm... I may need to wait for the next trainee before I can start looking again... Eep!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
唉，我还没找到丢掉的东西。
嗯......也许得等下一位学员来，我才能继续找......咦！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Oh~ You are pretty strong!
I'm so glad that someone strong like you came.
I wouldn't have last long here by myself.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
哦～你挺强的嘛！
能有你这样的强者来帮忙，真是太好了。
要是只有我一个人，早就撑不住了。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
...Oh you're back!
(Johan Opens the door and checks)
....!
Okay!!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
......哦，你回来了！
（约翰打开门查看）
......！
好！！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Go back and report to Ur.
That Glast Heim Abbey is clear now.
I need to stay and look for something... Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
回去向乌尔报告吧。
格拉斯特海姆修道院已经清理好了。
我得留下来找点东西......再见。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
20 Wraiths!
I'll watch your back!.
... Of.. Course.. I'll fight too!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
20只恶灵！
我会在后面掩护你！
......当......当然......我也会一起战斗！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
10 Evil Druids!
I'll watch your back, like last time.
... Of... Course... I'll fight them too!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
10只邪骸黑暗祭司！
我会像上次一样掩护你。
......当......当然......我也会一起战斗！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
This is Glast Heim Abbey.
Be careful, there are a lot of lost souls around here.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
这里是格拉斯特海姆修道院。
小心，附近有很多迷失的灵魂。

scripts.text: What? I came for training..
scripts.translation: 什么？我是来参加训练的......

scripts.text:
[Johan]
No no, that's the same thing!
Your training mission is to help me clear out this Abbey!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
不不，这本来就是一回事！
你的训练任务就是帮我清理这座修道院！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Phew... It's been so tough.
I can't run in by myself, but then Gargoyles attack me out here..
Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
呼......真是难办。
我不敢一个人冲进去，可待在外面又会被石像鬼攻击......
哈哈哈......

scripts.text:
[Johan]
This abbey is our responsibilty.
Just like other monasteries, this one has an underground graveryad as well, but..
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
这座修道院归我们负责。
和其他修道院一样，这里也有地下墓地，不过......

scripts.text:
[Johan]
As you well know, this castle... is not at a normal state.
I think that's causing these souls from being able to rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
你也知道，这座城堡......情况很不对劲。
我想这就是这些灵魂无法安息的原因。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Let's defeat the ones around here first, since going underground may be too much for just us.
I'll be testing how skilled you are as well...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
先解决周围的魔物吧。
只靠我们两个人，深入地下恐怕太勉强了。
我也正好看看你的本事......

scripts.text:
[Johan]
First target are the Wraiths.
You can tell them apart by their strange laugh.
They look like demons, but we can't tell for sure...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
第一个目标是恶灵。
它们的笑声很奇怪，很容易辨认。
看起来像恶魔，不过我们也不能确定......

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Defeat 20 Wraiths.
I'll assist you from here!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
击败20只恶灵。
我会在这里支援你！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
By the way, did you see those other monsters besides the Wraiths?
They are the corrupted souls of priests.
They are called 'Evil Druid' as well.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
对了，你看到恶灵以外的魔物了吗？
那些是堕落牧师的灵魂，也叫邪骸黑暗祭司。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Let's take care of these Evil Druids this time.
10 of them.
You can do it right?
I believe in you!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
这次来收拾邪骸黑暗祭司吧。
一共10只。
你做得到吧？我相信你！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Thank you! I really appreciate it!
I think I can enter without any worries now!
I hope those evil souls left it alone..
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
谢谢你！真是帮大忙了！
现在我可以放心进去看看了！
希望那些恶灵没碰我的东西......

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Hehe, I'll put in a good word to Ur!
You're a valient and skilled exorcist!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
嘿嘿，我会向乌尔好好夸夸你！
你真是个勇敢又能干的驱魔师！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
You can go back to Eden now
I'll stay and clean up the rest, hehe
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
你可以回伊甸园了。
我留下来收拾剩下的，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Uh... You didn't hear that did you?
Hahahahahahaha!!!
Hahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
呃......你没听见刚才的话吧？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！
哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
So, have you punished those Porcellio's yet?
I don't think you're done yet right?
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
三叶铁甲虫收拾了吗？
我看你还没做完吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What?
....
Hmm, Ur sent you?
Oh, that training mission thing.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
什么？
......
嗯？乌尔派你来的？
哦，那个训练任务啊。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What, You're done already?
I was just about to fall asleep... Oh well..
It can't be helped, I guess. Let's go to a different spot..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
什么，你已经做完了？
我刚才差点睡着......算了......
也没办法。我们换个地方吧......

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm not a thief...
It's a hard living.
Nor is there any real ambition.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我不是小偷......
日子不好过啊。
也没什么远大志向。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
The monsters are at the northern fields of Einbroch.
Find the Noxious...
Don't try to lie to me that you've finished hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
魔物在艾音布罗克北边的野外。
去找废气魔......
别想骗我说你已经猎杀完了。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Um...
I'm getting it done.
Hmm...
I'm still tired to finish...
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
嗯......
我会去处理的。
嗯......
我还是太累了，没法做完......

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What are you looking at?
You want something from me?
Mind your own business, go away..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
你看什么？
想找我干什么？
少管闲事，走开......

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What serious?
Have you made your report to Instructor Ur?
Einbroch has commissioned work out so that means more training.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
什么大事？
你向乌尔指导员报告了吗？
艾音布罗克发布了委托，也就意味着又有训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
You've came a long way, I won't make you do anything too tough, don't worry.
The fields outside of Einbroch isn't too bad.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
你走了这么远，我不会给你安排太难的任务，放心吧。
艾音布罗克外面的野地还算安全。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
And monsters here usually leaves me alone, so I can nap all day.
But there are some that bother me.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
这里的魔物通常不来烦我，所以我可以睡上一整天。
不过有几种总来捣乱。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Do you know Porcellios are?
Ugly looking insects... They steal too..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
知道三叶铁甲虫吗？
长得很丑的虫子......还会偷东西。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Let's defeat some of them as a warm up.
There are plenty of them around here. 30 shouldn't be too hard right?
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
先拿它们热热身吧。
附近有很多，打30只应该不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm not holding a grudge just because they ate my lunch.
I'll be resting here until you're done.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我才不是因为它们吃了我的午餐才记恨它们呢。
我就在这里休息，等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
No, what are you talking about?
Go... with you?
You can by yourself right?
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
不，你在说什么？
要我......跟你一起去？
你自己能行吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Okay, next task!
People of Einbroch say that the pollution is really bad in the north.
They are worried that pollution will drift into the town.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
好，下一个任务！
艾音布罗克的居民说北边的污染很严重，
担心污染会飘进城里。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
It's probably all those factories right there...
I guess I should still look into it.
The cause for the pollution... Find it and destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
大概是那边的工厂造成的......
看来我还是得调查一下。
找出污染源，然后摧毁它。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
30 Venomous and 5 Teddy Bears.
That should be good enough.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
30只毒魔和5只玩具熊。
应该就够了。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm sure you'll do fine without me watching.
To show my support, let me give you some EXP and HP recovery.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我不盯着你，你也能做得很好。
让我用经验值和HP恢复来表示支持吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
The monsters are at the northern fields of Einbroch.
Okay then, be safe.
I'm going to take a nap.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
魔物在艾音布罗克北边的野外。
那就小心点。
我要去睡一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
If you're hurt I'll heal you a bit.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
受伤的话，我会帮你治疗一下。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Good. Those monsters have been bothering the Einbroch workers.
That was great..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
很好，那些魔物一直在骚扰艾音布罗克的工人。
干得不错......

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I have some things to report to Instructor Ur.
I've been watching you closely and you've done well. Go back to Ur and deliver this report.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我有些情况要向乌尔指导员报告。
我一直在留意你的表现，你做得很好。回去把这份报告交给乌尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Yeah, if this is okay?
Ugh this is difficult.
I'll make you feel better though.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
嗯......这样可以吗？
唉，这真麻烦。
不过我会让你轻松一点。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Come practitioners?
Make things.
How convenient witchinya.
Heumnya. I'll sleep in one breath..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
来训练的人吗？
做点东西。
真方便啊，喵。
嗯......我要一口气睡过去了......

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
It's more than that~
Now where did the time go~
I thought you said you sent me~!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
还不止这些呢～
时间都去哪儿了～
我还以为你说要派我出去呢～！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
The biggest stumbling block is dealing with the Siromas.
Have you hunted 30 yet?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
最难对付的是小雪兽。
你已经猎杀30只了吗？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Have you finished hunting the 30 Siroma yet?
You've already done it once so this shouldn't be difficult...
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
30只小雪兽打完了吗？
你之前做过一次了，这次应该不难......

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Ah... It's over...
Good!
Your skills have been verified.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
啊......终于结束了......
很好！
你的实力已经得到验证。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Were you there yet?
Other people have come and go since you've been here last.
Now I don't have to get the materials myself.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
你终于来了？
你上次走后，这里来了不少人。
现在我不用自己去收集材料了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Ohh!
You've brought everything.
Okay, so just one last thing...!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦！
东西都带齐了。
好，最后还有一件事......！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Alas, is there anywhere where the buildup of ice caps is more than here?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
唉，还有哪里会积起这么多冰啊？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And you are?
Oh, you were sent here by Ur?
I don't know how long I've been waiting here in the snow.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
你是？
哦，乌尔派你来的？
我都不知道自己在雪地里等了多久。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
What is it? You'll help me. Is that right?
No, you don't have to do that.
I'm waiting for someone scheduled to help me.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
怎么了？你是想帮我，对吧？
不用了。
我在等另一个约好来帮忙的人。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
This is the ice dungeon of the northern plains.
Nothing like a cave that's cold the entire year.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
这里是北方平原的冰洞。
和那些一年到头都很冷的洞窟可不一样。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
So this is where the people of Rachel go for their ice supply.
But, this area is crawling with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
拉赫的人会来这里采冰。
不过附近有不少危险的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
One of those monsters is known as a Siroma.
They should be a good challenge for you.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
其中一种叫小雪兽。
对你来说应该是个不错的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Okay, then go in the cave and find those Siroma.
It's cold in there but this job has to be done.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
那就进洞找小雪兽吧。
里面很冷，但工作还是得做。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
OH, sometimes
You be careful in there.
Well, good luck~!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦，进去以后小心点。
祝你好运～！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Now, what have I happened to do next.
Those Siromas seem to be growing at a faster rate.
As before go and hunt 30 more Siromas and bring me some materials.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
接下来得做什么来着......
小雪兽似乎繁殖得越来越快。
和上次一样，再猎杀30只小雪兽，带些材料回来。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And get this... Well...
Please listen carefully
30 Ice Cubic
1 Sweet Sauce
1 Milk
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
还有这些......嗯......
仔细听好：
冰块一角30个
甜酱汁1份
牛奶1瓶

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I'm not just doing this for myself you know.
I'm doing this for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
我可不只是为了自己才这么做。
我是为了大家。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
That's the last of it anyways.
So hunt those Siromas and get the materials.
We understand each other?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
总之这是最后的要求了。
去猎杀小雪兽，把材料收集齐。
说好了？

scripts.text: What about you?
scripts.translation: 那你呢？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Me? Well of course... I'm going to stand guard here.
I... I'm a busy person!
Besides this is training so who are you to ask me what about me?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
我？当然是......留在这里站岗。
我......我可是很忙的！
再说这是训练，你问我干什么？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Go now!
Those Siromas are going to just get rowdier by the minute.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
快去吧！
小雪兽只会越来越闹腾。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Oh, you want help recovering your HP/SP huh?
You'll get nothing from me~!
What challenge would that be if I did that?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦，你想让我帮你恢复HP和SP啊？
我才不帮呢～！
那样还算什么挑战？

scripts.text: ...... Look

[Naomi]
Yes, yes? Why not?
...
Oh, that's right! I'm supposed to give you something.
You've done enough, I know.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
嗯嗯？为什么不呢？
......
哦，对了！我应该给你点东西。
我知道，你已经做得够多了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I'll inform Instructor Ur.
A few more stages left to go so don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
我会向乌尔指导员汇报。
还剩几个阶段，别担心！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Oh and congratulations!
This is the last training stage prepared!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
对了，恭喜你！
这是最后一个训练阶段！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I guess I should do some of this myself~
Muahaha~
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
看来我也该亲自做点事了～
哇哈哈～

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And don't forget the 30 Ice Cubic, 1 Sweet Sauce, and 1 Milk.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
别忘了带冰块一角30个、甜酱汁1份和牛奶1瓶。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Report back to Instructor Ur and report that the job is done.
Don't procrastinate.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
回去向乌尔指导员报告任务完成。
别拖拖拉拉的。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
So what's up?!
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
那，怎么了？！

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
The proof that you have there.
You're here in paradise.
Instructor Ur sent you?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你手里的证明......看来你来到乐园了。
是乌尔指导员派你来的？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Well, whatever the Nepenthes and Pinguicula proof has been collected.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
嗯，捕虫堇和食人花的证明都收集齐了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Oh, sorry.
I don't know much about the life of an adventurer.
I'm just a member of Eden Group...
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
哦，抱歉。
我不太了解冒险者的生活。
我只是伊甸园的一名成员......

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Can you find those two brothers?
Find out what's up with them.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你能找到那两兄弟吗？
查清楚他们那边出了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
........
Yes.
scripts.translation: 是。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Oh, my mistake.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
哦，是我搞错了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
How do you do?
Oh, so you're here for the training from Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你好。
哦，你是来参加乌尔指导员安排的训练的。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Ok, I'm in a bit of a situation right now so I asked Instructor Ur to use his missions to help.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
好吧，我眼下正遇到点麻烦，所以请指导员乌尔用他的任务帮个忙。

scripts.text: A situation?
scripts.translation: 遇到麻烦了？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Yes, 
Find Mine and do what he asks you.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
是啊。
去找米内，按他说的去做。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
We dispatched him to do something and he hasn't done it yet so I'm guessing he's either chickened out or failed.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我们派他去办点事，可他到现在还没办完。我猜他要么临阵退缩了，要么就是失败了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
So can you find him out there in Splendide Field?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你能去辉煌之野找到他吗？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Find him and figure out what the heck he's up to please.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
麻烦你找到他，弄清楚他到底在搞什么。

scripts.text: - You tell her about Meeru and Mine. -
scripts.translation: - 你把米鲁和米内的事告诉了她。 -

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Yeah? Oh what?
This is not really...
Ok I'll go deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
是吗？什么？
这实在不太......
好吧，我去处理他们。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Well, whatever the Nepenthes and Pinguicula proof has been collected.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
嗯，捕虫堇和食人花的证明都收集齐了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Your training is done so go back and talk to Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你的训练结束了，回去找指导员乌尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Your training is done so go back and talk to Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你的训练结束了，回去找指导员乌尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Hmm yes I saw.
I knew I should've asked you to hunt more than 1.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
嗯，我看到了。
早知道就该让你多猎一只了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
You think I'll lose!
...?
All of them... Who're you?!
Mine is a stooge?
He sent you to watch me!?
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
你以为我会输！
......？
你们全都......你是谁？！
米内是个跟班？
他派你来监视我？！

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
I'll just be here making sure other people hunt the Nepenthes. I might ask them to hunt more than 1 who knows.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
我就在这儿看着别人去猎杀猪笼草。说不定我也会让他们多猎几只，谁知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Something wrong?
Did you have trouble with that Nepenthes...
.........hyuk huk.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
怎么了？
猎杀那只猪笼草时遇到麻烦了吗......
......咳、咳。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Is hunting the Nepenthes too much for you?
You seem a bit flushed.
Fine I'll heal you!
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
猎杀猪笼草对你来说太勉强了吗？
你看起来脸都涨红了。
好吧，我来给你治疗！

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
What? Isn't that it?
... ...
Mine didn't send you did he?
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
什么？不是这样吗？
......
米内没派你来吧？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
What? Isn't that it?
... ...
Mine didn't send you did he?
So why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
什么？不是这样吗？
......
米内没派你来吧？
那你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Margaret sent me
scripts.translation: 是玛格丽特派我来的

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Ah, Margaret!
Mine and Margaret are always trying to mess with me because of my win-!
Gosh...
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
啊，是玛格丽特！
米内和玛格丽特老拿我的胜利说事，想捉弄我......
真是的......

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？

scripts.text: What do you win?
scripts.translation: 你赢了什么？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
It all started with them bickering.
Margaret was asked to scout for both of us. It's like what you're doing now.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
事情要从他们俩拌嘴说起。
玛格丽特被叫去替我们两边侦察，就像你现在做的事一样。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Mine said that he was strong enough to defeat any monster.
So I insisted that he go to either East or West of the camp and show me.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
米内说自己强到能打败任何魔物。
所以我就让他去营地东边或西边看看，亲自证明给我瞧。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Mine made an idle threat and huffed and puffed but didn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
米内只会放狠话，嘴上嚷嚷个不停，最后什么也没做。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Basically, Margaret didn't believe him and challenged him to kill 1 Nepenthes.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
总之，玛格丽特不相信他，就让他去杀一只猪笼草，算是给他出了道难题。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
So anyways now I'm charged with asking people to go and hunt 1 Nepenthes because of that bickering incident.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
结果因为那次争执，现在轮到我负责让人去猎杀一只猪笼草了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
It's really not that difficult to hunt 1 so just go to the field East of here and kill one of them.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
猎一只其实没那么难，去这边东面的原野杀一只就行。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Anyways you've proven that you're stronger than Mine ever made himself out to be.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
总之，你已经证明了自己比米内吹嘘的强多了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Well anyways here's a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
好了，给你一点小小的谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
I'll just be here making sure other people hunt the Nepenthes. I might ask them to hunt more than 1 who knows.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
我就在这儿看着别人去猎杀猪笼草。说不定我也会让他们多猎几只，谁知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh cruel world...
...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
这残酷的世界啊......
......
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Come on 5 Pinguicula.
Really how did you get here then?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
拜托，去猎杀5只捕虫堇。
说真的，那你又是怎么到这里来的？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Excellent!
Now I can go back to the camp and...
scripts.translation:
[米内]
太好了！
现在我可以回营地，然后......

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh cruel world.
...
Way to go passing by.
What a fiasco this has turned out to be
scripts.translation:
[米内]
这残酷的世界啊。
......
你路过得可真是时候。
事情怎么会闹成这副样子。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Margaret gets everything she wants back at the camp.
Don't you worry, I'm going back soon.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
玛格丽特在营地什么都不缺。
放心，我很快就回去。

scripts.text: Margaret sent me.
scripts.translation: 玛格丽特派我来的

scripts.text: Yeah I'm here...

[Mine]
Eh? Who!
I see. Is it that time already?
This has been difficult.
I'm in a crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[米内]
咦？谁啊！
我明白了，已经到约定的时间了吗？
这事真难办。
我现在可是焦头烂额！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh so you're not here by your own will eh?
So why even bother coming?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
哦，你不是自愿来的啊？
那你何必跑这一趟？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
You didn't want to be here right?
Margaret sent you instead of someone else I bet.
Whatever, anyway I'm in a crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[米内]
你本来就不想来，对吧？
我猜是玛格丽特派你来的，不是派了别人。算了，总之我现在焦头烂额！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok I don't want to admit it but you gotta help me out here.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
好吧，我不想承认，但你得帮我一把。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok just because I was complaining doesn't mean they have to send me here!
scripts.translation:
[米内]
我只是抱怨了几句，他们也不至于把我派到这种地方来吧！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I mean they've asked for too much of a simple person like myself.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
他们对我这种平凡人要求也太高了。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok here's the deal.
I'm supposed to hunt those Pinguiculas. Just 5 of 'em.
But you'll do that for me yeah?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
事情是这样的。
我本来该去猎杀那些捕虫堇，就5只而已。
不过你会替我去，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I promise you I'll give you something good.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
我保证会给你不错的东西。
谢了。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I mean, can you tell Margaret that it's all done?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
对了，你能告诉玛格丽特事情已经办妥了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh don't worry she won't mind. I'll just go back to doing what I was doing. Here's your reward.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
哦，放心，她不会介意的。我先回去继续做原来的事。这是给你的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
You're not lying about being a real adventurer are you?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
你不是在冒充真正的冒险者吧？

scripts.text: - You have too many items in your inventory to continue -
scripts.translation: - 背包里的物品太多，无法继续 -

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm, are you a member of Eden Group?
You need to be one of our members to use my services.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，你是乐园团的成员吗？
只有本团成员才能使用我的服务。

scripts.text: Strengthen Equipment
scripts.translation: 强化装备

scripts.text: Personal Request
scripts.translation: 个人委托

scripts.text: Give me new equipment.
scripts.translation: 给我新装备

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I will strengthen your equipment after you've done a personal request of mine.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
完成我的个人委托后，我就帮你强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Have you started the request of Instructor Ur?
I'm lending my services to those who are worthy.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你开始做指导员乌尔的委托了吗？
我只愿意为够资格的人提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Strengthen your equipment eh?
I'll strengthen the new Eden Group equipment for you by giving it a random stat boost.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
想强化装备吗？
我可以随机提升属性，帮你强化新的乐园团装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm equipment strengthening.
I don't exactly do that for just anyone.
The first step is at least a higher degree of training so have you done the Eden Group training yet?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，装备强化啊。
我可不会随便替谁强化装备。
至少要先完成进阶训练。你参加过乐园团的训练了吗？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Glad you're here.
As a blacksmith I am in need of Iron materials constantly.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你来得正好。
我是铁匠，平时总需要铁矿材料。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Okay, I'll give you equipment.
I'll give you good armor and equipment that you'll be proud of.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
好，我给你装备。
我会给你一套优质的防具，让你穿出去也觉得体面。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Have you gotten your gear yet?
I can give you the gear but I can't strengthen it for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你拿到装备了吗？
装备我可以给你，但强化我帮不了。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You can strengthen the equipment that I gave you.
Weapons Expert BK is at Eden Group Headquarters and he can do that for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我给你的装备可以强化。
乐园团总部有位武器专家BK，他能帮你强化。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Now, that's it.
That's enough for today.
For now, ask me to strengthen your equipment and I'll do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
好了，就到这里吧。
今天先这样。
现在你可以找我强化装备，我会帮你处理。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Let me guess...
You've brought me the best quality materials.
Good.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
让我猜猜......
你带来的是品质最好的材料。
很好。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I'm not permitted to do this by Instructor Ur.
Don't mess with me.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
指导员乌尔不准我这么做。
别想糊弄我。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Come back later.
You have to wait for some time first.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
过段时间再来。
你得先等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Uh-huh...
What are we going to... oh don't worry.
Come to me later.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯......
我们要做什么来着......哦，别担心。
晚些时候再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I asked you to get 20 Iron Ore, and 10 Iron.
I'm pretty sure that it isn't that difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我让你去找20个铁矿石和10个铁。
这点东西应该不难吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I asked you to get 20 Used Iron Plate.
I'm pretty sure that it isn't that difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我让你去找20个废铁板。
这点东西应该不难吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You have not awakened yet.
First do the missions set forth by Instructor Ur and I'll help you strengthen your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你还没有觉醒。
先完成指导员乌尔布置的任务，我才会帮你强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I won't help you unless you do that first!
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你不先完成那些任务，我就不会帮你！

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So what equipment do you want to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
那么，你想强化哪件装备？

scripts.text: Eden Group Manteau II
scripts.translation: 乐园团斗篷Ⅱ

scripts.text: Eden Group Armor IV
scripts.translation: 乐园团制服Ⅳ

scripts.text: Eden Group Boots IV
scripts.translation: 乐园团短靴Ⅳ

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eden Group Manteau?
I understand.
Remember the stats that are enhanced will be random.
You sure you want me to enhance this?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
乐园团斗篷？
我明白了。
强化属性是随机的，记住这一点。
你确定要我强化这件装备吗？

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text: Yes, enhance it.
scripts.translation: 好，帮我强化

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I understand.
Let's begin the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
明白了。
那就开始强化吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the Manteau?
I don't think you have it with you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯...你没有带乐园团斗篷吗？
我看你身上并没有这件装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You sure you don't want to enhance it?
It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
确定不强化了吗？
这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Ok, seems that the enhancement went well.
If you don't like the result then you can come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，强化似乎很顺利。
如果你不满意结果，明天再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eden Group Armor?
I understand.
Remember the stats that are enhanced will be random.
You sure you want me to enhance this?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
乐园团铠甲？
我明白了。
强化属性是随机的，记住这一点。
你确定要我强化这件装备吗？

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text: Yes, enhance it.
scripts.translation: 好，帮我强化

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I understand.
Let's begin the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
明白了。
那就开始强化吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the Armor?
I don't think you have it with you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯...你没有带乐园团铠甲吗？
我看你身上并没有这件装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You sure you don't want to enhance it?
It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
确定不强化了吗？
这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Ok, seems that the enhancement went well.
If you don't like the result then you can come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，强化似乎很顺利。
如果你不满意结果，明天再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eden Group Boots?
I understand.
Remember the stats that are enhanced will be random.
You sure you want me to enhance this?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
乐园团短靴？
我明白了。
强化属性是随机的，记住这一点。
你确定要我强化这件装备吗？

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text: Yes, enhance it.
scripts.translation: 好，帮我强化

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I understand.
Let's begin the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
明白了。
那就开始强化吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the Boots?
I don't think you have it with you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯...你没有带乐园团短靴吗？
我看你身上并没有这件装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You sure you don't want to enhance it?
It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
确定不强化了吗？
这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Ok, seems that the enhancement went well.
If you don't like the result then you can come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，强化似乎很顺利。
如果你不满意结果，明天再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I just want to be sure that you're worthy of using my services.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我只是想确认你够资格使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Besides, you won't have the equipment that I can enhance until you do those missions.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
而且，完成那些任务之前，你还拿不到我能强化的装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Of course there will be a reward eventually...
So...
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
当然，之后会有奖励......
所以......

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
